claims.claim: The Verge reports that Xbox CEO Asha Sharma told employees at an all-hands meeting that Microsoft is preparing to do something around Grand Theft Auto VI that no other platform holder is doing.
claims.evidence: The Verge, 6 Oct 2026, first paragraph. Opened 7 Oct 2026.
claims.quote: no other platform holder is doing

claims.claim: The Verge says, citing sources familiar with Microsoft's plans, that the remark referred to a deal for game-streaming rights that would let Xbox Cloud Gaming stream GTA VI at launch, and that it is not clear how long the agreement lasts.
claims.evidence: The Verge, 6 Oct 2026, paragraphs 1-2. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: The Verge's article carries a correction dated 6 October saying Xbox has clarified that the streaming deal is not exclusive and that GTA VI will not be streamed to PCs.
claims.evidence: The Verge, 6 Oct 2026, correction line at the foot of the article. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: After the denial, The Verge wrote that the deal appears to be for streaming on Xbox consoles only, and that the web browsers and apps that normally reach Xbox Cloud Gaming may not be able to stream the game.
claims.evidence: The Verge, 6 Oct 2026, paragraph 3. This is the outlet's reading of the denial, not a statement by Xbox. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: The Verge reports that Microsoft is opening Xbox Cloud Gaming next month with a pay-as-you-go option that is not tied to a Game Pass subscription.
claims.evidence: The Verge, 6 Oct 2026, paragraph 4. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: The Verge notes that Rockstar Games has not announced a PC version of GTA VI.
claims.evidence: The Verge, 6 Oct 2026, paragraph 2. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Kotaku reports that Xbox chief strategy officer Matthew Ball called the earlier report misreporting and said the game will not be streaming exclusively or to PC.
claims.evidence: Kotaku, update of 6 Oct 2026 11:42 pm, quoting Ball's post. The post itself was not opened. Opened 7 Oct 2026.
claims.quote: We are looking forward to launching GTAVI on XBOX November 19, though the game will not be streaming exclusively or to PC.

claims.claim: Before its update, Kotaku described the reported deal as meaning that no other cloud service would have the game and that PC users would be able to stream it.
claims.evidence: Kotaku, 6 Oct 2026, original body text beneath the update. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: IGN says it contacted Rockstar Games and Xbox for comment on the report.
claims.evidence: IGN, 6 Oct 2026. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: IGN notes that PlayStation holds marketing rights to GTA 6 and that Rockstar has promoted the game with footage captured on PS5.
claims.evidence: IGN, 6 Oct 2026, paragraph on PlayStation marketing. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: IGN recalls that The Verge recently reported Xbox was concerned about GTA 6 pre-orders on its platform, and that Matthew Ball denied this and said the game was breaking records there.
claims.evidence: IGN, 6 Oct 2026. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer notes that Rockstar has not announced a GTA 6 streaming deal with any provider.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 7 Oct 2026, final paragraph. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer reports that Game Pass members are now limited to 15 hours of cloud play a month at the highest tier, that Xbox Cloud Gaming launches in November as a standalone paid service for streaming games the user owns, and that a free ad-supported tier is being tested with Xbox Insiders.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 7 Oct 2026, paragraphs 4-6. Opened 7 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Eurogamer describes The Verge's report as having inferred the exclusive streaming rights from Sharma's remark to staff.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 7 Oct 2026, paragraph 2. Opened 7 Oct 2026.
